name: Chubu Steel Plate Co., Ltd.
summary: Chubu Steel Plate Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells steel plates in Japan. It operates through the Steel Related Business, Rental Business, Logistics Business, and Engineering Business segments. The company also engages in the installation, manufacture, and maintenance of equipment for steel manufacturers; metal processing; and warehouse business that focuses on storage and handling of hazardous goods, such as flammable substance, paint, and medicine. In addition, it is involved in the rental business and advertising business for making advertising signs, as well as offers rental grease-filters and maintenance service for kitchens.
